say.speaker: chespin
say.text: Strike all you like, raiders. You will tire long before my shell does.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Hold steady, young Chespin! Before we charge up that ridge, {lord}, check our formation and gear.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Now that I am marching with you, take a moment before each clash to pick who enters the fray and adjust where we stand on the trail.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Mind my veteran restraint too: if I take every knockout myself, you youngsters will miss out on vital battle experience. Let me soften tough foes while you finish them!
